about: Notes and Guidance: non-normative implementation and usage notes for Data Dictionary elements, shown on an element's page below its definition. Field notes are keyed by resource and standard name; lookup value notes by lookup name and Legacy OData value. A note shows on every version that has the element. Once a version's sheet carries a Notes and Guidance column, the sheet's text is used for that version instead.

Property.DaysOnMarket: Because the count follows each MLS's business rules, values are commonly not directly comparable across different MLSs.
Property.InternetAddressDisplayYN: This permission covers the listing address only. See also: InternetEntireListingDisplayYN.
Property.InternetEntireListingDisplayYN: This permission covers the whole listing. See also: InternetAddressDisplayYN.
Property.ListPrice: In Value Range Pricing, this is the upper value of the range and ListPriceLow is the lower value, so it is greater than or equal to ListPriceLow. See also: ListPriceLow.
Property.OriginalListPrice: See also: ListPrice for the current list price.
Property.PostalCode: This is a string field. In the United States it commonly follows USPS ZIP formats, either five digits or ZIP plus four. Other countries follow their own postal formats.
Property.PrivateRemarks: See also: PublicRemarks for remarks intended for public display.

Appliances.WasherDryer: In practice this value may describe either a separate washer and dryer pair or a single combined washer dryer unit.
Appliances.WaterPurifier: When ownership is known the more specific values WaterPurifierOwned and WaterPurifierRented may be used instead.

Heating.ActiveSolar: Active solar heating relies on mechanical equipment such as pumps or fans to circulate the heated fluid, unlike passive solar approaches that use no mechanical parts.
Heating.EnergyStarAccaRsiQualifiedInstallation: This value describes the quality of the installation rather than the equipment itself. See also: EnergyStarQualifiedEquipment.
Heating.FireplaceInsert: An insert is a distinct option from the open fireplace itself. See also: Fireplaces.
Heating.PropaneStove: This value refers to the stove appliance itself. See also: Propane, commonly used when propane fuels the central heating system rather than a standalone stove.
Heating.Radiant: See also: RadiantCeiling and RadiantFloor, which indicate where the radiant elements are located.
Heating.WoodStove: See also: Wood, which identifies wood as the heating fuel in general.

PropertySubType.Townhouse: A party wall is a shared wall on the common boundary between two adjoining units, typically jointly used by the owners on each side.
